campaignResolution.description: The focused campaign resolves after there has been no active war between members of the three opening strategic camps for a sustained peace period. Unrelated local wars do not prevent resolution.

minimumSuccess.description: A country must retain a viable sovereign political claim through campaign resolution. Temporary occupation is not automatically game over.

outcomeDimensions.description: Preserve an independent state, government or viable government-in-exile with a credible route to restoration.
Protect core territory and population centres and limit hostile occupation or destruction.
Limit military and civilian losses, displacement and infrastructure destruction.
Retain enough productive capacity, trade access, energy and critical supply chains to recover after the conflict.
Fulfil the diplomatic or military objectives the government actually adopted during play. Countries that remain neutral do not receive unchosen conquest objectives.

exampleAustralia.minimumSuccess: Australia remains a viable sovereign state when the systemic three-camp conflict has been settled for the required peace period.
exampleAustralia.dynamicRule: If Australia chooses guarantees, basing commitments, sanctions, intervention or territorial war aims, those choices become additional objectives rather than being scripted at scenario start.
